chatmoss_signalbox_0.text: Mind the levers. Each one moves a signal or a set of points, by wire and rod, out across the moss.
Signal boxes talk by bell code. One beat on the bell means 'attention, please'. It is a very polite language.
Out here the ground is so soggy the line is still, more or less, floating. Sphagnets love it, and croakles hop about when it drizzles.
